body.statement: Let \(\pi\in\mathfrak S_V\), and suppose the predecessor set of \(r\) under \(\pi\) is exactly \(A\). Then the original-label row \(B_\pi^{(a)}[r,\cdot]\) equals \(\beta^{(a)}(A,r)\) for every \(a\in M\). Hence that row is invariant to the order within \(A\) and to every suffix after \(r\).
body.justification: The immutable row is the model-specific write-once label that replaces the failed completed-path quotient.
body.gap: HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM, Appendix D.3, preserves the residual LiMVAM after removing a recovered root, but it does not express every orderwise structural row as a function of its original-label predecessor set for quotient enumeration.
body.consumer: A duplicate-free calibration solver can cache a row once and never replay the removal history that produced it.
